title: Tilly Lawless
gist: Prospect Magazine author index page for Tilly Lawless, a queer Sydney-based full-service sex worker and novelist, listing 51 articles under the 'Sex life' Lives column. No article body — signal is limited to bio facts and the recurring subject matter of the column.

insights.claim: Tilly Lawless is a queer, Sydney-based full-service sex worker and the author of two novels, Nothing But My Body (2021) and Thora (2024), writing a recurring 'Sex life' column for Prospect.
insights.so_what: Establishes a first-person practitioner byline as a standing feature in a mainstream UK ideas magazine.
insights.quote: Tilly Lawless is a queer, Sydney-based full-service sex worker. She is the author of two novels: Nothing But My Body (2021) and Thora (2024)
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: The index lists 51 articles, making this one of the magazine's high-volume Lives columns rather than an occasional contribution.
insights.so_what: Sustained column volume indicates the format has an established readership, a signal about mainstream editorial appetite for the subject.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: The listed headlines cluster on the psychology of the client relationship — seeing the man behind the façade, refusing to read punters' reviews, roleplay as healing — treating sex work as a source of social observation rather than as an issue to be litigated.
insights.so_what: Indicates a shift in mainstream ideas-press framing from policy debate about sex work to practitioner-as-observer commentary.
insights.locator: Lives / Sex life: As a sex worker, I see the man behind the façade
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: The column ranges well beyond its nominal subject into prison policy, friendship obligation, misogyny among gay men, motherhood, travel to Turkmenistan and reform of the ex-racehorse industry.
insights.so_what: Breadth confirms the column functions as general social commentary, so it is worth scanning beyond its titular topic.
insights.locator: Lives / I love rehoming ex-racehorses, but the industry needs reform
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: One listed headline argues the real prison scandal is not an officer having sex with an inmate, signalling a contrarian editorial stance on a story that received mainstream coverage.
insights.so_what: Marks where the column reliably diverges from tabloid consensus — the position most likely to shape elite opinion downstream.
insights.quote: Sex life: The real prison scandal isn’t an officer having sex with an inmate
insights.locator: Lives / Sex life: The real prison scandal
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
